row.evidence: TestRail's SSO guide says Enterprise SSO can auto-provision users on first sign-in, but "User statuses are not automatically synchronized"; no SCIM is documented on the pricing page or in any of the 558 help-centre articles.
row.notes: Status changed from gated to none. June listed SCIM on Enterprise, but no first-party source documents SCIM now: it is absent from the pricing page and from every help-centre article, including the API reference. The only automation is JIT auto-provisioning on Enterprise SSO (SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0 or OIDC), and IdP deactivations must be repeated in TestRail by hand. Prices also changed. A new Essentials plan costs $22/user/mo (annual, up to 5 users, Cloud only). Professional went from $37 to $38 and Enterprise from $74 to $78, both per user per month on annual billing. Enterprise is annual only. The Okta OIN app is SWA only (last updated 2017). The REST API is on every plan, with rate limits of 100, 180 and 300 requests/min by tier.

limitations.text: No SCIM endpoint; SSO auto-provisioning creates users but IdP deactivations are not synchronized. SCIM is absent from the pricing page and from the full help-centre index.

capabilities.notes: update_user accepts the add_user fields; deactivate/reactivate via is_active is inferred from the user object field and the shared field set.

endpoints.purpose: List users with access to a project

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logging exists on Enterprise (UI); no API endpoint documented.

rate_limits.text: Cloud REST API: 100 req/min (Essentials), 180 req/min (Professional), 300 req/min (Enterprise); HTTP 429 when exceeded.

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SWA as checked (last updated Aug. 7 2017). TestRail's own guide covers a custom Okta SAML/OAuth/OIDC app (c24).

entra.notes: TestRail documents SSO through an Azure app registration; no Entra gallery tutorial found (404).
